text:
lina-support: Heads-up — customer @emma-customer reporting a big incident: tenant T-9273 (eu-west dedicated) is getting routed to hosted us-east, causing high latency and 5xxs. Billing spike noticed. Repro steps included.

emma-customer: Yep — started around 2026-03-16 09:12 UTC. Most requests slow (1.8-3s) and ~5% 503s. Our logs show route header is eu-west but responses come from hosted nodes. We rely on dedicated for P95 latency.

omar-sre: Can you paste a raw request/response with x-request-id? Also any auth errors in your app logs?

emma-customer: sample curl:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SK.xxxxx" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: T-9273" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west" \\
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response headers show: X-Redwood-Pool: hosted-us-east, X-Request-Id: r-85a3

lina-support: pasted r-85a3 into logs:
```
[router] 2026-03-16T09:12:43Z id=r-85a3 tenant=T-9273 route=hosted-us-east fallback=true reason=pin_evicted ttl=0
[auth] 2026-03-16T09:12:43Z id=r-85a3 tenant=T-9273 auth_ok=true key_lookup=miss -> fallback
```

hana-eng: Interesting. Router log shows pin_evicted and auth key_lookup=miss. That suggests the dedicated pool's tenant key wasn't found in the local cache and router fell back. Can we confirm KMS jitter or key sync errors for eu-west?

kevin-platform: Checking key-sync for eu-west… I see a gap 09:10–09:15 where key-sync jobs failed (transient 502 from control plane). During that window pin refresh / cert retrieval returned 404 which triggers eviction.

omar-sre: OK hypothesis: pin refresh TTL expired while control plane briefly failed -> router marks affinity as evicted -> fallback route to hosted. That will cause cross-region latency and hosted billing.

billing-ops: FYI we automatically flagged an unusual hosted charge for tenant T-9273: +$1.2k over 2 hours (quick calc).

emma-customer: This is a big deal for us, can you reproduce reliably? We can hold traffic if needed.

hana-eng: Repro steps I used: block control-plane key-sync for eu-west for ~90s, then send requests with X-Redwood-Tenant header. Router transitions to fallback state. Sample repro script (internal):
```
# simulate control plane outage
iptables -I OUTPUT -d control-plane.eu-west -j DROP
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: T-9273" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .pool
done
iptables -D OUTPUT -d control-plane.eu-west -j DROP
```
Results: first ~20 requests still hit dedicated (cached), then router marks pin evicted and subsequent requests go to hosted.

omar-sre: Good repro. Two separate issues: 1) TTL/refresh aggressiveness + silent control-plane blips cause eviction -> fallback, 2) auth/key lookup falling back without clear alert. We need to reduce blast radius.

lina-support: Customer asked for mitigations and an ETA.

hana-eng: Short-term mitigations: increase pin TTL from 60s -> 5m, add jitter to key-sync backoff, and create an alert when eviction->hosted rate > 0.5% in 5m window. Also ensure router logs reason=pin_evicted are surfaceable to support UI.

kevin-platform: I'll open a config change for TTL and add a canary to ensure no unintended side effects. Rolling change to eu-west only.

matt-oncall: Created incident ticket INC-2319, assigned to hana + kevin, priority P1 for customer SLA. Noting contact: @emma-customer.

billing-ops: For billing impact, we can issue a temporary credit for the overflow usage once root cause confirmed. Need a request id list and timeframe.

emma-customer: Please confirm when safe to re-enable load — we paused some jobs.

hana-eng: ETA for TTL change: ~45m to canary, 90m full rollout if canary is clean. We'll also add a short-term healthcheck that queries key-sync and marks control-plane unhealthy earlier to avoid silent misses.

omar-sre: Follow-ups: add metric router.fallback.reason.pin_evicted.count, and alert when hosted_ingress_rate - dedicated_ingress_rate for a tenant > 0.1 for 5m. Also capture X-Request-Id list for billing reconciliation.

lina-support: I'll gather request ids and timeline from customer and paste here.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: platform/config/pin-ttl-change -> canary eu-west at 2165436120.

matt-oncall: Thanks team. Postmortem next steps: 1) confirm root cause (control-plane key-sync outage), 2) rollout TTL and alerting, 3) billing credit for T-9273, 4) customer comms draft. I'll start the comms thread. :thumbsup:

emma-customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep me looped.

lina-support: Collected request ids from 09:08–11:30 UTC: [r-85a3, r-8f4c, r-9b2d, r-10f5] — sending to billing separately.

billing-ops: Got the list. We'll draft a credit and hold until postmortem.

hana-eng: After initial canary, we saw no increase in error rate and key-sync alert triggered earlier. Locking change into next-hotfix deploy.

omar-sre: Marking this resolved for now pending postmortem and billing action.

lina-support: Closing the immediate support loop. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes.
